description: An open coloring book sits on a yellow table with a box of 64 Crayola crayons behind it, and a fish drawing is visible on the right page. The left hand rests on the page to steady it while the right hand holds a pink/red crayon and makes short back-and-forth strokes to fill in a horizontal stripe on the fish, shifting slightly along the stripe and then lifting the crayon briefly as the coloring section is completed.
